decide: Sign three unsigned commits yourself by 2026-09-26, or accept them unsigned; signing is recommended.
situation: Three commits landed while your key was locked, so they carry no signature. A signature only shows who wrote a commit; nothing is broken.
yours_because: Only your key can produce your signature.

choices.label: sign-them
choices.in_practice: You unlock your key and sign the three commits.
choices.undo: cannot be undone: the signatures stay in history.

choices.label: accept-unsigned
choices.in_practice: A dated note records the acceptance.
choices.undo: Reversible: you can still sign them on any day.

if_nothing: On 2026-09-26 accept-unsigned is taken for you.
evidence_line: Both paths are written down in the committed governance text of this repository.

terms.signature: a stamp proving who made a commit
